title: The FOXO pathway mediates a conserved mechanism of antioxidant defense against microplastic-induced toxicity in Aurelia coerulea polyps and mouse liver.
authors: Chen, Xiaoxiao; Zhu, Yina; Wu, Feng; Li, Liangzhi; Wang, Yi; Danso, Blessing; Yang, Zhixiao; Peng, Xiao; Pozzolini, Marina; Tang, Qinglong; Xiao, Liang; Dai, Xiaojie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究微塑料胁迫下两种生物FOXO通路介导的抗氧化与DNA损伤修复机制，虽涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Microplastics are emerging as a critical class of pollutants with a pervasive presence in the atmosphere, oceans, and terrestrial environments, raising global concern. However, it is unclear whether there are conserved mechanisms for the response of microplastic damage to different species. Aurelia coerulea polyps and mouse models were exposed to microplastic environments to assess their growth effects and mechanisms. The similarities and differences in the defence mechanisms of the two species after exposure to microplastics were analysed by means of phenotypic observations, transcriptome sequencing, pathological sections, oxidative stress indicators, explosions and molecular docking. Exposure to 200 mg/L of PS-MPs resulted in morphological changes, tissue damage, and oxidative stress in polyps. Exposure to 600 mg/L of PS-MPs led to increased toxicity in the mouse liver, including rupture and apoptosis of mitochondria and nuclei in hepatocytes, as well as oxidative stress. Meanwhile, we found that their antioxidant defense and DNA damage repair pathways were significantly altered. In addition, we found that the same loci existed in the foxo pathway in both species, and the enriched gene sequences were 48.33 % similar. Molecular docking showed conserved regions between polyps NLK and mouse Mapk13, indicating similar kinase activities, but overall structural and functional differences suggest species-specific. This finding provide new insights into understanding the mechanisms of toxicity of MPs to different organisms.
abstract_zh: 微塑料正成为一类关键污染物，在大气、海洋和陆地环境中普遍存在，引发全球关注。然而，目前尚不清楚微塑料损伤对不同物种的响应是否存在保守机制。本研究将海月水母（Aurelia coerulea）水螅体和小鼠模型暴露于微塑料环境，以评估其生长效应及机制。通过表型观察、转录组测序、病理切片、氧化应激指标、爆发和分子对接等手段，分析了两种物种在暴露于微塑料后防御机制的异同。暴露于200 mg/L的PS-MPs导致水螅体出现形态变化、组织损伤和氧化应激。暴露于600 mg/L的PS-MPs导致小鼠肝脏毒性增加，包括肝细胞线粒体和细胞核的破裂与凋亡，以及氧化应激。同时，我们发现它们的抗氧化防御和DNA损伤修复通路显著改变。此外，我们发现两种物种的foxo通路中存在相同位点，富集基因序列相似度为48.33%。分子对接显示水螅体NLK与小鼠Mapk13之间存在保守区域，表明具有相似的激酶活性，但整体结构和功能差异提示物种特异性。这一发现为理解微塑料对不同生物体的毒性机制提供了新见解。
